dynamic_reads.reason: Restores caller-provided runtime overrides; each actual compilation input still needs classification at its consumer.

Copies an existing metadata probe environment, omitting runtime-only loader injection, tracing and profiling under the documented deployment contract. Actual builds retain the caller environment; compiler and dependency search settings remain visible to probes.

ASCEND_HOME_PATH.reason: Selects compiler, linker, SDK headers and libraries through simpler env_manager.

CC.reason: Runtime build-tool selection; direct kernel compilation uses its selected toolchain object.

CCACHE_CC.reason: Deprecated alias of CCACHE_COMPILER; selects the compiler a ccache wrapper runs.

CCACHE_COMPILER.reason: Forces the compiler a ccache wrapper runs, overriding the name it was invoked by.

CCACHE_CONFIGPATH.reason: Selects the ccache configuration file, which may set the compiler to run.

CCACHE_DISABLE.reason: Takes ccache out of the compilation chain.

CCACHE_NODISABLE.reason: Counterpart of CCACHE_DISABLE; keeps ccache in the compilation chain.

CCACHE_PREFIX.reason: Inserts another program before the compiler, e.g. distcc.

CCACHE_PREFIX_CPP.reason: Inserts another program before the preprocessor.

COMPILER_PATH.reason: Can redirect compiler subprograms; resolve their contents.

CPATH.reason: Additional implicit include roots; inventory ordered roots and contents.

CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH.reason: Additional C++ include roots; inventory ordered roots and contents.

CXX.reason: Runtime build-tool selection and injected flags; do not substitute this for resolved tools.

C_INCLUDE_PATH.reason: Additional C include roots; inventory ordered roots and contents.

GCC_EXEC_PREFIX.reason: Can redirect compiler subprograms and resources; resolve their contents.

LANG.reason: Tool locale can affect parsing and generated diagnostics; resolve with LC_ALL precedence.

LC_ALL.reason: Overrides tool locale; account for the effective compiler environment.

LC_CTYPE.reason: Character interpretation in compiler subprocesses; account for locale precedence.

LD_AUDIT.reason: Supported deployments use loader injection only for allocation or observation, without changing compiler selection, inputs or generated semantics. Probes omit it; unobserved semantic inputs require an explicit deployment fingerprint/epoch or disabled caching.

LD_DEBUG.reason: Loader diagnostics/profiling are omitted from metadata probes to avoid contaminating identity or adding probe output work; actual execution keeps the caller setting.

LD_DEBUG_OUTPUT.reason: Loader diagnostics/profiling are omitted from metadata probes to avoid contaminating identity or adding probe output work; actual execution keeps the caller setting.

LD_LIBRARY_PATH.reason: Dynamic dependency search input; fingerprint the libraries actually selected.

LD_PRELOAD.reason: Supported deployments use loader injection only for allocation or observation, without changing compiler selection, inputs or generated semantics. Probes omit it; unobserved semantic inputs require an explicit deployment fingerprint/epoch or disabled caching.

LD_PROFILE.reason: Loader diagnostics/profiling are omitted from metadata probes to avoid contaminating identity or adding probe output work; actual execution keeps the caller setting.

LD_PROFILE_OUTPUT.reason: Loader diagnostics/profiling are omitted from metadata probes to avoid contaminating identity or adding probe output work; actual execution keeps the caller setting.

LIBRARY_PATH.reason: Can change linker inputs; inventory the selected libraries.

PATH.reason: Executable search input; fingerprint resolved tools and their resources.

PTOAS_PYTHON.reason: Packaged PTOAS launcher interpreter selection; inventory interpreter resources and native dependencies.

PTOAS_ROOT.reason: Use the shared ptoas resolver; inventory the selected launcher and its dependencies.

PTO_ISA_ROOT.reason: Derived runtime hint; the pinned PTO-ISA resolver owns the actual include root.

PYPTO_AUTO_DEPS_LOOP_CARRY_DEBUG.reason: Diagnostic tracing of loop carry dependency analysis only.

PYPTO_CACHE.reason: Persistent storage policy; does not change generated code.

PYPTO_CACHE_DIR.reason: Persistent storage location, captured separately from content identity.

PYPTO_CACHE_EPOCH.reason: Explicit installation revision token invalidating cached artifacts after same-version local patches.

PYPTO_CACHE_IDENTITY.reason: Selects build identifiers or the legacy content inventory; policies use distinct persistent identities.

PYPTO_CACHE_READONLY.reason: Persistent storage write policy, captured per request.

PYPTO_CODEGEN_MAX_WORKERS.reason: Bounds parallel codegen workers; does not select generated operations.

PYPTO_COMPILER_TIMEOUT.reason: Bounds compiler and linker execution time; successful binary contents are unchanged.

PYPTO_COMPILE_PROFILING.reason: Enabled compilation profiling must run compiler stages on each request.

PYPTO_DISABLE_PTO_ISA_TREM_PATCH.reason: Debug-only bypass of the temporary A2/A3 TREM backport; switches the PTO-ISA sources PyPTO compiles against between the pinned tree and its patched worktree.

PYPTO_EMIT_DEBUG_RUNNER.reason: Controls generated replay files; integration must honor output requests. Only an explicit enabled value requests fresh compilation; 0/false/no do not.

PYPTO_EMIT_PTO_LOC.reason: Resolve effective source-location emission into compilation options.

PYPTO_LOG_LEVEL.reason: Logging threshold; does not select compiler transformations.

PYPTO_PROG_BUILD_DIR.reason: Selects the base for new private build/runtime directories. Does not force compilation or change artifact identity; existing objects retain their directories.

PYPTO_PTOAS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.reason: Bounds each PTOAS kernel compilation; successful generated output is unchanged.

PYPTO_REBUILD_FROM_PTO.reason: Explicitly rebuilds edited artifacts; incompatible with immutable reuse. Only an explicit enabled value requests fresh compilation; 0/false/no do not.

PYPTO_RUNTIME_LOG_SYNC.reason: Synchronizes runtime and compiler logging thresholds only.

PYPTO_SKIP_RUNTIME_PIN_CHECK.reason: Suppresses the runtime-pin diagnostic only; the installed runtime revision it reports is separately part of the binary cache identity.

PYPTO_VERIFY_LEVEL.reason: C++ captures its default once; use the effective verification policy.

PYPTO_WARNING_LEVEL.reason: C++ captures its default once; use the effective diagnostic policy.

PYTHONHASHSEED.reason: Compiler Python hash iteration order must be audited before reuse across seeds.

PYTHONHOME.reason: Interpreter resource selection; inventory the actual interpreter installation.

PYTHONNOUSERSITE.reason: Python console-script import selection; inventory the effective wheel and interpreter inputs.

PYTHONOPTIMIZE.reason: Changes Python compiler execution semantics; captured in the persistent specialization identity.

PYTHONPATH.reason: Import search input; inventory actual imported compiler and runtime modules.

PYTHONSAFEPATH.reason: Python console-script import selection; inventory the effective wheel and interpreter inputs.

PYTHONUSERBASE.reason: Python console-script import selection; inventory the effective wheel and interpreter inputs.

SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.reason: Compiler date/time macro and reproducibility input; include the effective value.
